title: pr-thread-ref names a work package whole
objective: The PR check names a work package as the id door gives it, and it cuts no address itself.
body:
## Rows

C7, the cut half (triage P29). Found still open by dc at bd1aa3c6c.

## Deliverables

- `.github/scripts/pr-thread-ref.sh:100` drops `sub("/.*"; "")` and names the package whole, eg "Work package ST0096/01 exists".
- `tests/unit/pr_thread_ref.bats` follows.

## Approach

dc's option (a): the script reads the door's answer as it is, and no interface changes. Option (b), a `thread` field in the door's answer for a package, changes a contract (cc's meaning, ic's shape), and it is not taken.

## Dependencies

None.

## Risks

A PR body that names only a package passes as before, and the message now names the package instead of its thread.

## Verification

Before the bank, the builder runs clippy and critic-shell on its diff.

The batch decides this package: one `bin/devbin gate all` and one `bin/devbin test shell` at main's HEAD, after the last bank lands, booked by vc with the Desk. No gate and no suite runs for this bank alone.

## Seat and size

dc (CI). XS.
